vehicles.title: 2024 Tesla Model 3
vehicles.note: Low-poly FBX variant (the archive also has a high-poly one). Numbered materials: 04 body paint, 31 tyres, 33 rims, 14 glazing, 13/20/26/27 headlamp units, 10/25/30/36 tail lamps; 18 cabin screen, 35 brakes, 38/39 rear lettering dropped.

vehicles.title: 2024 Leapmotor C01
vehicles.note: Seat frames are parked below the floor in the source; anything wholly under the sills (source z < 0.1) is interior.

vehicles.title: 2025 Xiaomi YU7
vehicles.note: Numbered source materials: 01 paint, 03 lamp lenses, 07 rims, 09/10 tyres, 12 lamp emitters, 13 number plates, 14 cabin, 16 indicators, 17 brakes; the rest black trim.

vehicles.title: 2024 Li Auto MEGA
vehicles.note: Numbered source materials; the full-width rear light band is a dark trim strip, recovered with a tail box.

vehicles.title: BAIC BJ40
vehicles.note: Object names are pinyin: fxp steering wheel, zk/cd cabin parts, shachepan brake discs, dipan chassis, wange trim. Round headlamps are dark housings (head box).

vehicles.title: 2019 Ford Ranger Raptor CIVIL (Cities Skylines)
vehicles.note: Loose Sketchfab .glb (no archive): one mesh and one textured material, so roles come from the base-colour and emission textures (colourFrom texture). Double-cab pickup; replaces the procedural mobility-double-cabin (legacy alias).

vehicles.title: 2019 Lamborghini Huracán GT3 EVO Racecar
vehicles.note: The racing livery is texture-only artwork on the Paint and Coloured panels; both become plain paint and carbon aero panels are painted too. A livery shell covers the lamp lenses (lamp_decals).

vehicles.title: 2024 GMC Hummer EV SUV
vehicles.note: The source ships without its removable roof panels; a tinted glass cap (caps) closes the roof so the cabin is culled.
